purpose: Committed record of the corrected HOTA/DetA/AssA numbers for all three trackers, since benchmark_outputs/ (where scripts/evaluate_hota.py writes hota.json) is gitignored -- without this manifest, the readme's Tracking table pointed at files no clone of the repo actually has.

bug_fixed.description: evaluate_hota.py pre-filtered ground_truth to predictions['frame'] before calling compute_hota(), silently dropping any frame where the tracker predicted zero boxes instead of scoring it as a false negative. hota_metrics.py's build_hota_data() already unions GT and prediction frames correctly (matching tracking_metrics.py's MOTA/IDF1 accumulator) -- the fix removes the redundant, incorrect pre-filter.

gt_only_frames_affected.measured_by: counting, per tracker, GT frame indices absent from that tracker's own prediction CSV, across all 7 VisDrone2019-MOT-val sequences

comparison_to_buggy_numbers.note: The bug's quantitative impact was small: every metric moved by at most 0.002 across all three trackers. The detection-limited-not-association-limited conclusion (DetA nearly flat across trackers while AssA moves with tracker choice) is unchanged. The original numbers are still wrong and must not be cited -- this manifest and the readme's Tracking table now carry the corrected values.

caveat: This is a provenance-controlled integration baseline on VisDrone2019-MOT-val, not an official VisDrone/MOTChallenge benchmark (no ignore-region handling) or Vietnam-domain tracking evidence -- same caveat as the readme's Tracking section. benchmark_outputs/{predictions,hota.json} themselves remain local and gitignored; this manifest is the committed, hash-backed record of their results, and re-running scripts/evaluate_hota.py against the same predictions_manifest_sha256 must reproduce the metrics above.
